assessment: Methylation of adenine residues in mRNA has been shown to be a regulator of many factors in heath and disease. In these studies, the authors present data that this modification of the mRNA for EGFR (epidermal growth factor receptor) through down regulation of the methylating enzyme METTL3 by shear stress is a contributor to vascular pathology in a model with some features of accelerated atherosclerosis.
